content:
“You were top in your fencing club.”

**Natural Stance** is a Strength-based perk in *Fallout 76*, renamed and redesigned in the *CAMP Revamp* update.

Reduces Stagger if melee weapon is used.

| Rank | Cost | Description | Form ID | 
| ★ | 1 | While equipping a melee weapon, reduce Incoming Stagger by 25%. | 003440AB | 

- Before update 62, the perk provided +10%/+15%/20% damage to one-handed melee weapons and was named "Expert Gladiator."
